g.title: Campus
g.text: CAMPUS APP PLATFORM — discussion mind map
Requested apps • Proposed catalogue • Shared foundation | Institutional research pending

g.title: n2
g.text: • Bus code / series → route → destination campus
• Pickup points and alternative buses to the same campus
• Daily rotating bus QR: scan → sign in → choose numbered seat
• One seat per rider; prevent duplicate seat claims
• Seated / standing check-in; remaining seat count
• Check-out releases seat; reservations are separate
• Drivers, students or staff may contribute GPS with consent
• OpenStreetMap + Leaflet; last-update time and GPS accuracy
• Stale / offline status; no report means unknown, not cancelled
• QR screen or fresh print daily; copied QR is not proof of presence
• Browser GPS needs HTTPS, permission and connectivity
• Foreground updates only; locked-screen tracking is not guaranteed

g.title: n15
g.text: • Green generation: solar / wind / other sources
• Battery charge / discharge and stored balance
• Energy balance, losses and campus-wise readings
• Admin / explicitly assigned energy role only
• Live meter / inverter integration is a later design decision

g.title: n23
g.text: • Holiday calendar and campus rules / engagements
• Prevent self-approval and duplicate overlapping requests
• Workweeks, quotas and local policies need specification
• Hourly time entry / payroll is not in the prototype

g.title: n31
g.text: • Role-based learning: student / staff / other assigned roles
• Assessment, certificates and LMS integration: later scope

g.title: n37
g.text: • Resource types / users / quotas: to be defined
• Scheduling / allocation / costing: to be defined

g.title: n41
g.text: • Clarify staff hiring versus student placement workflows

g.title: n123
g.text: • Enable only selected apps per campus

g.title: n155
g.text: Current code: Python + NiceGUI + SQLite; not Odoo

g.title: n156
g.text: Odoo option: Python backend + XML / JavaScript-Owl UI + PostgreSQL

g.title: n157
g.text: Odoo Community first; verify each app and dependency licence

g.title: n158
g.text: Open-source maps: no mandatory paid key; hosting and tile-policy limits remain

g.title: n159
g.text: Institutional service-catalogue research has NOT been completed

g.title: n160
g.text: MIT / IIT / Oxford are reference institutions, not verified source lists

g.title: n161
g.text: Analysis only: no Odoo migration or new platform launcher has started

g.title: n162
g.text: Agree scope / Odoo version / deployment before implementation
